title: LeetCode 26: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array
description: Given an integer array `nums` sorted in non-decreasing order, remove duplicates in-place such that each unique element appears only once. Return the list of unique elements.
constraints:
0 <= len(nums) <= 3 * 10^4
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
explanation: Comparing each element to the last stored unique element compresses the sorted list in O(N) time.
